title: Making an Appointment
summary: A patient calls a dental clinic to book an appointment and reschedules when the first slot is not possible.
description: An elementary phone-conversation dialogue. Learners hear days of the week, times of day, and useful phrases for confirming, refusing, and rescheduling appointments.

vocabulary.definition: an arranged time to meet someone, usually for a service
free to do something at a particular time
a plan of times when things will happen
to arrange a new time for something
to say that something is definitely true or arranged

dialogue.text: Good morning, City Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Hello, I would like to make an appointment with Doctor Lee.
Sure. Are you available this Thursday afternoon?
I am afraid not. I work on Thursday afternoons.
No problem. What about Friday morning at ten?
Friday at ten is perfect. Is the clinic easy to find?
Yes, we are on Park Avenue, next to the post office.
Great. Can I confirm the appointment for Friday at ten?
Yes, confirmed. We will see you on Friday.

questions.q: Who does the caller want to see?
Why can't the caller come on Thursday?

trueFalse.statement: The appointment is for Friday morning.
trueFalse.explanation: The caller and the receptionist agree on Friday at ten.

trueFalse.statement: The clinic is next to the bank.
trueFalse.explanation: The receptionist says the clinic is 'next to the post office.'

teacherTips: Drill 'I am afraid not' and 'That works for me' as fixed phrases for politely accepting or refusing offers.
Practise the phone opening: 'Good morning, [company]. How can I help you?'
Follow-up writing activity: students write a short email confirming an appointment.

es.title: Pedir una cita
es.summary: Un paciente llama a una clínica dental para concertar una cita y la reprograma cuando el primer horario no es posible.
es.description: Un diálogo elemental por teléfono. Los estudiantes oyen días de la semana, partes del día y frases útiles para confirmar, rechazar y reprogramar citas.

vocabulary.definition: un horario acordado para encontrarse con alguien, normalmente para un servicio
libre para hacer algo en un momento concreto
un plan de horarios en los que sucederán cosas
establecer un nuevo horario para algo
decir que algo es definitivamente cierto o está acordado

questions.q: ¿Por qué no puede venir el jueves?

trueFalse.statement: La cita es el viernes por la mañana.
trueFalse.explanation: El llamante y la recepcionista acuerdan el viernes a las diez.

trueFalse.statement: La clínica está al lado del banco.
trueFalse.explanation: La recepcionista dice que la clínica está 'next to the post office'.

teacherTips: Practica 'I am afraid not' y 'That works for me' como frases fijas para aceptar o rechazar ofertas con educación.
Practica la apertura por teléfono: 'Good morning, [company]. How can I help you?'.
Actividad de escritura de seguimiento: los estudiantes escriben un correo corto confirmando una cita.
